description: Security audit of a small web app for DOM-based XSS: locate the real sink (innerHTML fed from location.hash) among a safe look-alike, and write a findings report with CWE, severity, a working PoC payload and a remediation.

criteria: The report identifies the innerHTML sink in renderResults (webapp/app.js) fed by location.hash as the DOM XSS (CWE-79), provides a working hash-based PoC payload (e.g. an img onerror or svg onload vector), explains why the nearby textContent use is safe, and recommends a safe sink or sanitisation - without modifying the web app.
